result.title: PRELUDE: Separating Common Components from Target-Specific Dependencies for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
result.summary: Multivariate time series forecasting often improves the prediction of a target by modeling the interactions among variables, and cross-variable modules such as cross-sectional pooling, inter-variable attention, and graph structures are used to construct such interactions. However, by intervening on the cross-variable reading of existing models at inference time, we find that although these models substantially reduce forecasting error through cross-variable interaction, their reading is nearly identical for all targets: the gain appears to come from dependencies among variables but mainly comes from the common component. We term this phenomenon spurious dependency and attribute it to common-component confounding: present in every variable, the common component affects how reading distinguishes sources, so that reading tends to be shared across targets and concentrates on a few similar averages; dependencies thus make up a small share of the read-in content, and a common component composed of several drivers is only partly captured. Theoretical analysis further shows that the common component and dependencies place different requirements on reading and should therefore be handled in different ways. Accordingly, we propose PRELUDE, a separated-reading framework that estimates the common component holistically through cross-sectional pooling and multiple common factors, and reads dependencies for each target via lead-lag relations in the innovation space obtained by prewhitening. Extensive experiments on 16 real-world datasets from four domains show that PRELUDE effectively mitigates spurious dependency and achieves the best overall performance: it attains the best MSE on 23 of the 24 short-horizon and air-quality settings and reduces the average MSE by 6.1% relative to the strongest baseline.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究多变量时间序列预测中跨变量交互模块的实际作用，通过在推理时干预跨变量读取，发现各目标的读取内容近乎相同、增益主要来自所有变量共有的「公共成分」，称之为 spurious dependency；进而提出分离式读取框架 PRELUDE，用截面池化和多公共因子整体估计公共成分，并在预白化后的新息空间中按 lead-lag 关系为每个目标单独读取依赖。
AI.relevance_reason: 其推理期干预式诊断与「公共成分 vs 目标特异依赖」的拆分思路，可供核查 LVR 中读取内容是否被全局共有信息主导、而非任务相关视觉证据，涉及视觉旁路与贡献分配问题，但属时间序列远域迁移推测。
